whenToUse: You look at the relationship between two values (distance and time, price and sales).
There are dozens of points or more.
whenNotToUse: Change along an ordered axis (use a line chart).
You'd show a third value too (use a bubble chart).
There are only a few points (use a table).

alternatives.name: Bubble Chart
alternatives.reason: Adding a third value as circle size.

accessibility: It finds the nearest point, so people don't have to hit a small dot exactly.
Points have white outlines so each shows even when overlapping.
Opening the table view shows every point as a table.
